grass-a#0.notes: three green summits under a grey crown on one broad body, meadow-green slopes tapering to points: one great form

snow-a#0.notes: three snow-capped summits on one body over a snowfield foot, clean silhouette, lit from the left

badlands-a#0.notes: three flat-topped buttes on one strata ridge over a red scree skirt; reads as one big mesa range

sand-a#0.notes: tall sandstone mesa, a spire and two knobs on one body rising from drifted sand; top complete (outline on row 0)

grass-b#0.notes: four green summits on one body with grey tips; slopes a deeper green than the meadow but one great form

grass-c#0.notes: one broad high green mountain with a grey crest and two shoulders, meadow-green slopes tapering out

snow-b#0.notes: four snow-capped peaks on one long body over a snowfield foot

snow-c#0.notes: the round snow dome behind the peaks reads as a snowball or a moon

badlands-b#0.notes: a broad strata mesa with a lower butte over a flared red scree skirt; one big table form

badlands-c#0.notes: a long fluted red cliff ridge with two hoodoo spires and a butte, one body

sand-b#0.notes: three rounded wind-carved sandstone summits on one body rising from drifted sand

sand-c#0.notes: two stacked round table rocks read as a layered cake

steppe-a#0.notes: the straw foot spreads as flat horizontal strips with a stepped, straight-cut bottom

steppe-b#0.notes: one high sharp tan summit with two lower crags and long spurs over a straw foot

jungle-a#0.notes: three moss-capped limestone towers joined on one body over a jungle-green foot

wasteland-c#0.notes: a high craggy basalt summit with two lower ones over grey ash slopes; tip closed by a recorded cap
